title: person_update_event signature and its test must change together with the key format
answers: How do I read the $set key in the person update load-gen test?
body:
person_update_event(base, event, user) in rust/capture-load-gen/src/event.rs receives the distinct id (`&self.distinct_ids[index]`) at its call site in the event factory.
The unit test in the same file's tests module derives the key with `format!("loadgen_last_update_{user}")` from the event's distinct_id.
If the key format changes, update the generator and that test's lookup together. The test also asserts every update value is unique, so keep values unique per event.
